'''Meirm Speeder Emporium''' was a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] manufacturing company run by [[Torsha Dawun]]. Its main headquarters was in [[Meirm City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]].
